# The Hadwiger-Nelson Problem

The Hadwiger-Nelson problem asks for the minimum number of colors required to
color the plane such that no two points at unit distance from each other have
the same color.

*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hadwiger%E2%80%93Nelson_problem)

This file points to the canonical formalization in `FormalConjectures.ErdosProblems.«508»`.
-/

review.notes: The reviewed file introduces no mathematical declarations, answer slots, or status attributes. It only imports the canonical Erdős 508 formalization and documents the redirect. Its description agrees with the cited Wikipedia source, which still records the answer as unknown among 5, 6, and 7. For context, I inspected the imported statements and definitions and compiled /workspace/review/scratch.lean, proving that the imported graph is n-colorable (equivalently, has chromatic number at most n) exactly when a coloring of the whole Euclidean plane by Fin n separates every unit-distance pair. Empty-vertex, zero-chromatic-number, and self-adjacency checks also passed. The additional Erdős website request was blocked by Cloudflare; the target's own Wikipedia reference was accessible and sufficient. The target file was not modified.
